source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: sanitation AND (urban OR city OR slum) AND (politics OR governance OR access)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:sanitation AND (urban OR city OR slum) AND (politics OR governance OR access),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("sanitation" AND ("access" OR "governance" OR "politics") AND ("city" OR "slum" OR "urban"))
